0.why: src/Chord4Roy.cpp process(): setVoltage(..., i) for 13 channels and setChannels(13)

comment: The output always carries thirteen channels, and the mute channels are 0V or 10V rather than pitches, so the 1V per octave range applies only to channels 1 to 6 and 13. The style CV writes its result back into the panel switch every sample, so that switch cannot be moved by hand while a cable is in its jack. The README says bar chords do not exist for min6 or Sus and the code confirms it: rows 15 and 16 of the chord table, which are the bar shapes for min6 and Sus, are exact copies of the open-neck rows 7 and 8. Every input is read with getVoltage(), so a polyphonic cable into one of them is read on its first channel only. The chord names here are the ones the module's own display prints.
